summary.headline: IREM Co.,Ltd. issues KRW 2.5bn private convertible bonds (25th series), conversion price KRW 2,130
summary.what_happened: IREM Co.,Ltd. decided on Aug 7, 2026 to issue its 25th series of unlisted, unguaranteed convertible bonds via private placement, with a total face value of KRW 2.5bn (KRW 2,499,000,000) and a maturity date of Aug 18, 2031. The initial conversion price is KRW 2,130 per share, and the filing states the bonds will be paid for in part by transferring shares of a company named 원픽이앤씨 (Onepick E&C). This report is a corrected filing (정정신고) that amends the original filing first submitted on Aug 7, 2026.
summary.why_it_matters: Convertible bond issuances can lead to dilution of existing shareholders if the bonds are converted into new shares, and conversion price adjustment clauses can change the number of shares issued over time. Private placements of this kind are generally sold to a limited group of investors rather than the public.
